newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle Monday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle Monday roundup - USDA.

text.p: DODGE CITY, July 15 (Reuder) - Trade was quiet on Monday, with no sales slaughter steers or heifers confirmed, USDA said. Inquiry was moderate and demand light.

Sales were confirmed for the week to date on 5,500 cattle, mostly previously contracted or formulated cattle. Asking prices $64.00-$66.00, mostly $64.00-$65.00, bids $62.00. Last sales at $62.00 Friday. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Confirmed - none Last week - 42,800 Last year - none
Wk to date - 5,500 Last week - 49,700 Last year - 7,200
